meta.name: deck-tech-sharing
meta.description: GitHub-dark + JetBrains Mono + 终端代码块, 含 agenda + Q&A

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用代码风格制作技术分享幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用幻灯片做技术分享，想要代码风格排版
copy.tagline_en: Create tech-sharing slides with code-style layout
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often make slides for tech sharing and want a code-style layout

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按“技术分享 Deck”模板生成幻灯片,包含封面、议程、正文代码块、Demo 页和 Q&A 页,整体使用 GitHub-dark 配色与 JetBrains Mono 字体。
howto.when: 当你提出要做工程内部分享或会议演讲的幻灯片,或要求按这个 deck 模板来排版时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个技术分享 Deck,主题是 CI 流水线优化。
say.note: 会得到从封面到 Q&A 的完整页结构。

say.text: 给这段代码做一页 GitHub-dark 风格的代码块页。
say.note: 正文页会带上终端风格的代码块。

say.text: 加一页 Demo 页,用终端截图展示运行效果。
say.note: Demo 页采用终端截图布局。

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude generates slides from the “Tech Sharing Deck” template: cover, agenda, content with code blocks, demo page with terminal screenshot, and Q&A, using GitHub-dark colors and JetBrains Mono.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a tech-sharing or conference talk slide deck, or request to use this deck template.

say_en.text: Create a tech sharing deck about CI pipeline optimization.
say_en.note: Returns a full deck from cover to Q&A.

say_en.text: Make a GitHub-dark code block page for this code.
say_en.note: The content page gets terminal-style code blocks.

say_en.text: Add a demo page showing terminal output as a screenshot.
say_en.note: The demo page uses a terminal screenshot layout.
